description: This file defines a Spring component that listens for NotificationEvent instances and processes them by retrieving notification data and invoking a listener, using thread-local context management.

classes.name: SpringNotificationEventListener
classes.description: A Spring application listener component that handles NotificationEvent objects, logs processing, manages thread-local context, and delegates to another listener.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles NotificationEvent, initializes thread context, retrieves notification data, calls the delegate listener, and resets context.
